commits_data.title: ipars: eomtype should not be global
commits_data.message:
ipars: eomtype should not be global

The eomtype variable is used only inside dissect_ipars. Make it a local
variable. It's always set before it's used, there's no need for an
initial value.

commits_data.title: ipars: don't throw an exception under if (tree)
commits_data.message:
ipars: don't throw an exception under if (tree)

Always parse the complete packet. We want to see parsing errors (exceptions
from the proto_* functions) in any case, not just if we have a tree.

commits_data.title: ipars: pinfo is used
commits_data.message:
ipars: pinfo is used

pinfo is used in dissect_ipars, remove the _U_ qualifier.
